## Summary

- Describe the change and why it belongs in the public repository.

## Type of change

- [ ] Docs or content update
- [ ] Front-end UI update
- [ ] Static generation or SEO update
- [ ] Community or contributor workflow update

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, `.env` files, database dumps, logs, or server-only config.
- [ ] I checked the affected pages on desktop or mobile when UI changed.

## Notes for reviewers

- Add screenshots, routes to check, or follow-up notes when useful.
